scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with finite supplementary diagnostics. Closest primary full texts inspected; general weighted cycle-flow formulations may make portions derivable after specialization. No independent priority or mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: For n>=5 single-edge-defect, equal-frequency attractive sine cycles and 0<h<1/4 only. Classifies linearly attracting stationary classes in the principal-increment winding sectors +1 and -1 and their paired fold saddles; not other windings, basin geometry, nonstationary dynamics, or nonlinear behavior at the neutral fold.
title: Sharp weak-link threshold for winding-one attractors on a sinusoidal cycle
